_doc: Front-facing verification ledger. Gate: enriched_book_is_verified (tools/invariants.py). A claim may carry a search-enrichment entry (i.e. be FRONT-FACING) only if its book is in books_verified, or its id is in claims_verified, or its id is in the frozen grandfathered set. This makes the ORIGINAL failure impossible: you cannot newly front-face a quote from a book whose source has not been verified. The grandfathered set is the honest record of what was already enriched before the gate existed -- it may SHRINK (as books get verified) but a claim appearing in it that was not frozen there is RED.
_standard: books_verified = the book's source is audited-pristine. claims_verified = this claim was checked against a RENDERED PAGE IMAGE. Two grades sit in this list and the difference is stated rather than blurred: (a) DEFECT-SPAN verified -- the flagged span(s) were char-diffed against the page and usually the surrounding sentences too; (b) WHOLE-VERBATIM verified -- the entire quote was compared end to end, which is the stronger claim and covers the 2026-08-02 wave-1 control sample (30 claims, all flagged whole_verbatim_checked) and the wave-3 non-word sweep (86 claims, where readers found defects OUTSIDE the flagged tokens, proving they read the whole span). Deliberately EXCLUDED from this list: claims resolved only by PDF text layer, by a second OCR pass, by line geometry, or by corpus-internal attestation -- all weaker evidence, labelled as such. ★ SECOND-OCR AGREEMENT IS NOT VERIFICATION: measured 2026-08-02, 7 of 30 claims where both independent OCR passes agreed STILL carried a defect, so the 1,121 corroborated-but-unread claims remain in the backlog by measurement, not by oversight.  ★ WAVE 1, 2026-08-02: 213 further claims (tier A of the 443-claim read list, plus a fresh 30-claim control) were WHOLE-VERBATIM read across 141 page groups by 16 independent readers, each claimed defect then re-rendered and attacked by a separate skeptic. 211 are added here; IMMORT-000230 and LETS-000278 are deliberately WITHHELD because each still carries a known unfixed claim-EXTENT defect (a swallowed page separator, and a verbatim two characters short). CONTROL RESULT: 4 of the 30 both-passes-agreed claims still carried a defect (13%), against 7 of 30 in the first control. Combined 11 of 60. The ~997 corroborated-but-unread claims therefore remain in the backlog by measurement, not oversight.  ★ WAVE 2, 2026-08-02: 212 further claims whole-verbatim read across 140 page groups (the tier-B dropped-text and alignment-slip residue, the 2 remaining tier-A, and a THIRD independent control). CONTROL RESULT 2 of 30 (7%); running total across three controls 13 of 90 (14%). The two claims WITHHELD after wave 1 (IMMORT-000230, LETS-000278) had their extent defects repaired here and are now included, as are EPIGEN-000124 and -000125, whose swallowed page separators were repaired and whose spans were re-cut against the page.  ★ WAVE 3, 2026-08-02: 12 further reader-facing occurrences across 11 claims read against their pages. THESE ARE DEFECT-SPAN VERIFIED, NOT WHOLE-VERBATIM — the readers were pointed at specific marks (ASCII-vs-curly apostrophes, a spurious space inside a number) and measured those, not the whole quote. Recorded at the weaker grade deliberately. RARE-000237 is included because its page WAS read end to end; its single-quote glyph was ruled UNREADABLE at scan resolution and left unchanged.

_books_verified_why.dddl-3e-2011: audited-pristine (purity-status); BLUEPRINT §1 names it and iaiyh as the only two.

grandfathered.reason: Enriched BEFORE this gate existed, from books whose source is not yet fully verified. An explicit BACKLOG, not a waiver: membership asserts only 'this was already front-facing on 2026-08-02', never 'this is correct'. It SHRINKS as claims move into claims_verified. 1,925 at freeze -> 1,900 (2026-08-02, earlier session) -> 1716 after the 2026-08-02 corroboration + vision campaign moved 184 page-read claims out. -> 1505 after the 2026-08-02 wave-1 tier-A page-read campaign moved 211 more whole-verbatim-read claims into claims_verified. -> 1292 after the 2026-08-02 wave-2 tier-B page-read campaign moved 213 more. -> 1283 after wave 3 moved 9 more.

history.how: Four page-read waves: 29 corroboration disagreements (tier A1/A2), 45 wave-1 (30-claim control sample of AGREEING claims + 15 ours-garbled), 32 subscript-damage claims, 86 non-word-scan claims. Every claimed defect had to survive an independent skeptic; 4 were refuted and never reached the source.

Wave 1 of the 443-claim page-read list: 213 claims (tier A2/A3/UNLOCATED plus a fresh 30-claim control) grouped onto 141 distinct pages and read by 16 independent readers under a WHOLE-VERBATIM contract, with every claimed defect re-rendered and attacked by a separate skeptic instructed to default to refuted when glyphs were unclear. 118 came back clean, 44 defects in our own text were confirmed and 41 source edits applied (kv 448 -> 449), 41 previously-unlogged deliberate divergences were recorded, 8 book-typo proposals were left for human ruling, and 2 claims were refuted. IMMORT-000230 and LETS-000278 were WITHHELD from claims_verified because each still carries an unfixed claim-extent defect.
history.control_result: 4 of the 30 claims where BOTH independent OCR passes AGREED still carried a defect (13%). First control was 7 of 30. Combined 11 of 60. Agreement is corroboration, not verification.

history.how: Wave 2 of the 443-claim page-read list: 212 claims across 140 page groups, 16 independent readers under a whole-verbatim contract, every claimed defect attacked by a separate skeptic (4 of 35 refuted). 151 CLEAN, 26 defects in our text confirmed, 1 real dropped-text defect, 25 previously-unlogged deliberate divergences recorded, 4 book-typo proposals left for a human ruling. 28 source edits applied plus 4 claim-extent re-cuts; kv 449 -> 452. A new gate shipped in the same patch: verbatim_no_transcription_scaffolding (board 83 -> 84).
history.control_result: 2 of 30 (7%). Across three independent controls: 7/30, 4/30, 2/30 = 13 of 90.

history.how: Wave 3 — the 11 reader-facing sibling occurrences waves 1 and 2 left unread. DEFECT-SPAN grade, not whole-verbatim. 11 confirmed and fixed, 1 refuted to UNREADABLE and left alone. kv 453 -> 454.
